clue.text: Scowled when depressed

definitions.meaning: to lour or lower is to frown darkly, so this is the past tense of that verb
pushed down to a lesser height, the past tense of bring down

explanation.surface: Someone frowned because they were feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: frowned (from lour, to look sullen) and brought down to a lesser level.

clue.text: Keeping records is a feller's job

definitions.meaning: entering details in a log or journal
a feller cuts down trees, the work of a lumberjack

explanation.surface: Bookkeeping as one man's occupation.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: entering details in a record, and the timber trade of cutting trees.

clue.text: Bumptious youngster who photographs a flogger

parts.note: a whipper is one who flogs
a snapper is slang for a photographer

explanation.surface: A cheeky youth who takes pictures of a man with a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: A presumptuous young person, an impertinent upstart.

clue.text: A hill-climb schedule

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means reading upward, so the letters run in reverse

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Timetable for a hill-climbing race.
explanation.walkthrough: TOR is a craggy hill, common in the English West Country.
explanation.definitionFit: A rota is a roster listing who does what and when.

clue.text: Proud to become a social misfit

indicators.note: to become something is to change into it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Arrogance can turn one into an outcast.
explanation.definitionFit: A dropout is someone who rejects conventional society or abandons a course.

clue.text: Is able to accommodate large family

indicators.note: to accommodate is to house or take in, so one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: is able means can
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A house that can take in a big household.
explanation.definitionFit: A clan is an extended family group, especially in Scotland.

clue.text: Make good sauce

definitions.meaning: to recover lost ground, make up a deficit
an older spelling of ketchup, the tomato condiment

explanation.surface: Prepare a nice condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: draw level after falling behind, and a variant spelling of the tomato condiment.

clue.text: In war especially the Greeks sought his aid

definitions.text: In war especially the Greeks sought his aid

indicators.note: in means the letters lie within the words that follow

explanation.surface: In battle above all the Greeks prayed to him for help.
explanation.walkthrough: The god sits inside 'war especially', and the whole clue describes him.
explanation.definitionFit: Ares was the Greek god of battle, invoked by warriors.

clue.text: Money in the bank needed by a tightrope walker

definitions.meaning: the sum remaining in an account
steadiness that keeps a funambulist on the wire

explanation.surface: A high-wire act requires funds.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the amount left in an account, and the poise of a wire walker.

clue.text: Successful business prosecution is an absolute certainty

definitions.meaning: a company found guilty in court
a belief held with complete confidence

explanation.surface: Winning a case against a company is a sure thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a company found guilty, and a strongly held belief.

clue.text: A source of profit to the Tulliver family

definitions.text: A source of profit to the Tulliver family

parts.words: A source of profit to the Tulliver family
parts.note: the idiom for anything turned to advantage, and the Tullivers in George Eliot's The Mill on the Floss own a flour mill, which literally needs corn to grind

explanation.walkthrough: The Tullivers run Dorlcote Mill in George Eliot's novel The Mill on the Floss, so grain brought for grinding is their literal income.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means anything useful or profitable, literally corn brought to be ground.

clue.text: Self-righteous admission from a Zulu regiment

definitions.meaning: someone confessing to being pious, saying I am pi (pi is slang for sanctimonious)
a body of Zulu warriors in southern Africa

explanation.walkthrough: PI is old British school slang for pious or sanctimonious, so a prig might admit 'I'm pi'.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as a confession of piety (I'm pi), and a word for an armed band of Zulu warriors.

clue.text: Doctor takes royal companion to a Yemeni port

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
CH is a Companion of Honour, an order bestowed by the monarch
taken as written

explanation.surface: A physician brings a courtier along to a harbour in Arabia.
explanation.walkthrough: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British honour conferred by the sovereign.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a Red Sea port in Yemen, once famous for coffee exports.

clue.text: It may signal disaster for old people

parts.note: people means men, humans generally

explanation.surface: Something warns that the elderly face catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent or sign of future events, often of trouble to come.

clue.text: Forgetfulness is a hindrance to the ambassador

parts.note: a let is an obstruction, as in without let or hindrance
HE is His Excellency, the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: Absent-mindedness hampers the envoy.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the river of the underworld whose water makes the dead forget.
explanation.definitionFit: The underworld river whose waters bring oblivion, hence oblivion itself.

clue.text: Figure out only about five

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: sole means only, single
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Work out just roughly five.
explanation.definitionFit: To work out or find the answer to a problem.

clue.text: Man conceals a weapon out of habit

indicators.note: a piece that conceals another holds it inside itself

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman, a man
an arm is a weapon, as in firearm

explanation.surface: A man hides a gun purely out of routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of habit' reads as 'from routine', but habit is the monk's robe, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a religious robe, an article of clothing.

clue.text: Suggest a short work written in plain language

indicators.note: one piece written in another is placed inside it

parts.note: prose is ordinary language, as opposed to verse
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Recommend a brief piece composed in simple words.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward an idea for consideration, offer it.

clue.text: Woeful spirit of a woman beset by a curse

indicators.note: a thing beset by another is surrounded by it

parts.note: a bane is a curse or cause of ruin
she is the pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: The sad ghost of a woman plagued by a curse.
explanation.walkthrough: A BANSHEE is the wailing female spirit of Irish folklore.
explanation.definitionFit: In Irish folklore, a wailing female phantom whose cry foretells death.

clue.text: It's an advantage to be born healthy

parts.note: ne is French for born, used of men as nee is of women
fit means in good health

explanation.surface: Coming into the world in good shape is a blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefit is a gain or good thing, something advantageous.

clue.text: Iron taken up, melted and re poured out

indicators.note: in a down clue, taking up reads the letters upward, in reverse

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
fused means melted together

explanation.surface: Iron lifted, melted and poured out again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Re' is a leftover link here; 'taken up' turns FE into EF.
explanation.definitionFit: To effuse is to pour forth a liquid, so effused means poured forth.

clue.text: A real tonic, however one regards it

indicators.note: reading the word from either end gives the same thing, so the letters are a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A genuine pick-me-up, whatever view you take.
explanation.definitionFit: A reviver is a drink or stimulant that restores one's spirits, a pick-me-up.

clue.text: Coach is right to oppose racial agitation

indicators.note: agitation stirs and churns, so these letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A trainer is correct to stand against racial unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coach' looks like a trainer, but it is a railway carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A railcar is a single powered railway coach.

clue.text: Seamen can appear in tattered clothing

indicators.note: to appear in something is to show up inside it

parts.note: rags are torn, worn-out clothes
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Sailors may turn up wearing shabby clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a verb, but it is a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratings are ordinary sailors below officer rank.

clue.text: Pinches small quantities of whisky

definitions.meaning: squeezes sharply between finger and thumb
drams or small measures of spirits

explanation.surface: Someone tweaks drams of Scotch.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: sharp squeezes, and small measures of spirits.

clue.text: A priest confronts Italian demon

parts.note: Fr is short for Father, a priest
It is short for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: A clergyman faces an Italian devil.
explanation.definitionFit: An afrit is an evil spirit in Arabian mythology.

clue.text: Small cottage for northern resident

parts.note: a cot is a small cottage, a poetic word

explanation.surface: A tiny cottage for someone living up north.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living in Scotland, north of England.

clue.text: Jazz tune with a classical Indian melody

parts.note: a rag is a piece of ragtime music, a jazz forerunner

explanation.surface: A jazz number played with an Indian classical air.
explanation.definitionFit: A raga is a melodic framework in Indian classical music.

clue.text: A little lower down a limb

definitions.meaning: a young animal that lows, a baby cow
the fleshy back of the leg, partway down

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower' is one that lows, or moos, not 'more low'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a young cow, which moos, and the muscle at the back of the lower leg.

clue.text: Lateral thinking society with no membership fees

parts.note: costing nothing to join, hence free
an association is a society or club

explanation.surface: A creative-thinking club that charges nothing to join.
explanation.definitionFit: Free association is a psychological technique of letting ideas lead to one another without logic.

clue.text: A minor drawback

annotationWithheld.why: 'A minor drawback (4)': WARD is DRAW reversed, but the single word 'drawback' gives both the fodder (draw) and the reversal indicator (back), one word doing two jobs, which the check refuses

clue.text: Makes pure and sin-free in disposition

indicators.note: disposition means arrangement, so these letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Purifies and is free of sin by temperament.
explanation.definitionFit: To refine is to remove impurities from something, purifying it.
